name: Furusawa Kosuzu
source:
The younger sister. She's very shy, even around her father, and has a hard time speaking her mind. She's still very young, has no knowledge of sex, and has a perfectly flat chest which Asumi makes fun of. She has her first period during the course of the story.

Everyone calls her Suzu instead of Kosuzu.

She calls her father 'Papa'.
